facts.statement: Moog's product page calls Mother-32 a semi-modular analog synthesizer that works without patching and has a 32-point patchbay, a 32-note step sequencer, and MIDI-to-CV.
Monophonic analog; one oscillator (pulse and saw), one white noise generator, one external audio input; 13-note keypad.
Patchbay is 32 jacks of 3.5 mm.
60 HP Eurorack mounting dimensions with 26 mm depth; draws 230 mA from +12 V on a 10-pin header; included supply 110-250 VAC to +12 VDC 1 A; 2.8 W; 3.5 lb; 12.57 x 4.21 x 5.24 in.
Page states it can be relocated into a Eurorack enclosure and several units can be combined, via a wooden-sided aluminum enclosure.
Audio out is quarter-inch TS line shared with a TRS headphone jack; external audio in is 3.5 mm; MIDI IN is 5-pin DIN.
Spec lists a VCO modulation input normalled to the EG and an external-audio mixer input normalled to white noise.

Listed inputs include external audio, mix CV, VCA CV, VCF cutoff and resonance, VCO 1V/octave, VCO linear FM, VCO modulation, LFO rate, Mix 1/2, VC mix control, mult, gate, tempo, run/stop, reset and hold.
Listed outputs: VCA, noise, VCF, VCO saw and pulse, LFO triangle and square, VC mix, Mult and Mult 2, Assign, EG, KB, Gate.
VCO pitch input is stated as 1V/octave and a separate linear FM input exists; mixer CV crossfade range is stated as +/-5 V.
Gate threshold, trigger level and output voltage ranges are not given on the product page.
facts.locator: Mother-32 product page (absence in Specs table)

facts.statement: Oscillator 8 Hz to 8 kHz (16 kHz maximum with LFO/CV); pulse and saw; frequency control +/- 1 octave.
Modulation destinations: pulse width, oscillator frequency, filter cutoff, with polarity; VCO mod input normalled to EG.
20 Hz-20 kHz switchable low-pass/high-pass 4-pole transistor ladder filter.
Envelope is selectable AD (multi-trigger) or ASD (single-trigger).
LFO triangle or square; panel rate 1-350 Hz (600 Hz max).
Step sequencer has 32 steps with 64 sequence locations; keyboard and step-edit modes.
Panel controls: tempo, swing, run/stop, hold, reset; glide can be set per step.
Tempo, run/stop, reset and hold are listed among patchable inputs; sequencer clock, clock/2, clock/4, accent and step 1 are assignable-output choices.
Product-page walkthrough titles mention ratcheting and per-step gate length; no parameter ranges given.
VC mixer crossfades the selected oscillator wave and external audio; a second VC mixer cross-fades two DC-coupled signals.
The only stored items named in specs are 64 sequence locations.
The page does not describe saving panel settings or patch-cable layouts.
MIDI IN is a 5-pin DIN; MIDI control covers note, gate and pitch bend; mod wheel, aftertouch and velocity are available through the assignable output.
Assignable output offers 16 functions: sequencer accent, clock, clock/2, clock/4, decimated ramp/saw/triangle, stepped random, step 1, MIDI velocity, aftertouch, pitch bend, CC1, CC2, CC4, CC7.

VCO pitch input is labelled 1V/octave. Reviewer found the VCF and LFO do not track exactly 1V/oct as shipped; Moog said only trimmers critical to interconnection were fitted and 1V/oct use is possible via an external attenuator or the VC Mixer.
facts.locator: Review, The Synth section (VCF and LFO paragraphs); Patchbay table

facts.statement: MIDI notes 0 to 120 (10 octaves) are converted to CV spanning -5 V to +5 V.
Patchbay legends: plain text marks inputs, boxed text marks outputs, a white ring around the nut marks gate inputs. 32 x 3.5 mm jacks; only five short patch cables are supplied.
facts.locator: Review, The Patchbay box; In Use section

facts.statement: Named patch points listed by the review (input/output column pairing is lost in the flattened table, so only the names are recorded): External Audio, Mix CV, VCA CV, VCF Cutoff, VCF Resonance, VCO 1V/octave, VCO Linear FM, VCO Modulation, LFO Rate, Mix 1, Mix 2, VC Mix Control, Mult; outputs VCA, Noise, VCF, VCO Saw, VCO Pulse, LFO Triangle, LFO Square, VC Mix, Mult 1/2, Assign, EG, KB; gate inputs Gate, Tempo, Run/Stop, Reset, Hold.
No audio or CV peak-to-peak voltage is given for the patchbay in this review; gate threshold and trigger levels are also not stated (+5 V pulses are named only for assignable-output functions).

Single VCO with sawtooth and pulse (PWM). Only one wave is heard without cables, both are on the patchbay. Three pitch CV inputs; portamento; stated 1V/oct range 8 Hz to 8 kHz, about 16 kHz maximum. Agrees with Moog page values.
Four user-reachable trimmers: VCO offset, frequency-control gain, external 1V/oct gain, keyboard CV gain. There are none for filter or LFO tracking.

24 dB/oct Moog ladder, switchable low/high-pass. Reviewer measured cutoff from 17 Hz to above 21.5 kHz; the high-pass mode behaves unlike a textbook HP. Cutoff and resonance each have CV inputs on the patchbay.
facts.locator: Review, The Synth (filter paragraphs); Specifications box

facts.statement: Wikipedia infobox calls the filter a state-variable low/high-pass design, which conflicts with Moog's 4-pole transistor ladder (F-003-014) and the reviewer's ladder description. Uncited; treated as likely error.

Switchable AD (multi-trigger) and ASR (single-trigger) contour generator. Moog told the reviewer nominal attack is 1.25 to 3000 ms and decay/release 1.25 to 7000 ms; no times appear in the literature. Wikipedia lists it as an AR envelope.
facts.locator: Review, The Synth (contour generator paragraph); Wikipedia infobox

facts.statement: Triangle and square, both available at once on the patchbay, range about 0.1 to 600 Hz in the review spec box. Moog's page gives 1-350 Hz panel / 600 Hz max (F-003-016), so the lower limit differs by source. LFO can serve as a second oscillator but does not track 1V/oct exactly.

32 steps, 64 memories. Per-step pitch, gate length, slew, ratchet and accent; swing; rests/ties. Sequencer is hard-wired to VCO pitch, gate and EG trigger. Keyboard or MIDI note transposes a running sequence. Hold and reset during play.
facts.locator: Review, Keyboard, Sequencer & MIDI; In Use

facts.statement: Internal clock by default; MIDI Clock accepted (Tempo knob then divides); Tempo CV input also takes clock pulses and DIN Sync, selectable in Setup mode.
facts.locator: Review, Keyboard, Sequencer & MIDI; Assignable Output box

facts.statement: VC mixer 2 is not pre-patched. With nothing patched it outputs 0 V at full counter-clockwise and +5 V at full clockwise; input 1 replaces the 0 V end and input 2 the +5 V end.

Saved sequences go to 64 memories. Wikipedia likewise says 64 sequences of up to 32 notes. Neither source says panel-knob or patch-cable settings can be stored; the sound itself is set by 14 knobs and 9 switches.
facts.locator: Review, Keyboard...; In Use; Wikipedia infobox Storage

facts.statement: Assignable output (Setup mode) offers 16 CVs: nine sequencer-derived (accent default, clock, /2, /4 as +5 V pulses; ramp, saw, triangle -5..+5 V; random per step; step-1 trigger +5 V) and seven MIDI-derived (velocity, channel aftertouch, pitch-bend, CC1, CC2, CC4, CC7), all -5..+5 V. Only one is active at a time.

Receive channel 1-16 set in Setup; MIDI Clock, Start/Stop/Continue and Program Change (selects sequence memories) are accepted. No MIDI Out or Thru. Review text also lists portamento and sustain as translatable, but the box table does not include them (internal inconsistency).
facts.locator: Review, Keyboard, Sequencer & MIDI; Assignable Output box

facts.statement: Wikipedia infobox says velocity and aftertouch expression 'no'; the SOS review says both are recognised and one can be routed to the Assignable output.

Panel 319 x 107 mm (60 HP), case 319 x 107 x 132 mm, 1.6 kg; 12 V DC 1 A wall adapter, max draw 230 mA; single 1/4 in TRS output for line and headphones. Wikipedia: panel removable and usable as 60 HP Eurorack module.
facts.locator: Review Specifications box; Wikipedia Eurorack compatibility

facts.statement: Reviewer says the manual's largest part covers the keyboard and sequencer and contains nine example patches. The manual itself was not read.
facts.locator: Review, Keyboard, Sequencer & MIDI; In Use

facts.statement: Search results show a 60-page English manual on third-party sites, a Moog-hosted firmware page, and a Version 2.0 addendum adding sequencer functions. Not opened.
VCA offers On (drone) and EG (contoured) modes and feeds the single 1/4 in output.
One-in/two-out buffered multiple; a mult input and two outputs appear in the patch point list.
